title: Replace human-readable English StateError messages with stable codes in the DAO layer

evidence.quote:
throw StateError(
        'Cannot deactivate the last active curriculum for this profile',

throw StateError(
        'INSERT OR IGNORE collided but the companion has no ulid set — '
'Cannot seed study day defaults: curriculum_tracks row $trackId not found',

why: All four throw a plain English sentence instead of a stable code/enum. EH-5 exists because this is an EN+Hebrew app — if any of these ever reaches presentation (a catch-and-display-e.toString() somewhere upstream, or a crash reporter surfaced to a bilingual support flow), the message renders untranslated English with no ARB key to localize it.
recommendation: Introduce a small typed error (e.g. sealed DaoError with named variants, or a code enum carried on a custom Exception) for these four call sites; have callers map codes to AppLocalizations strings at the presentation boundary.
acceptance_criteria: The 4 sites throw a typed/coded error instead of a raw English StateError string.
A grep-based Rule-0 check (e.g. `grep -rn "StateError('[A-Z]" lib/core/database/`) is added to catch new pre-formatted messages in the DAO layer.

corrections: study_day_config_dao.dart quote is actually at line 219, not 218 (218 is the `throw StateError(` line).
